offering_description.value: Sells Tru Niagen and other nicotinamide riboside (NR) supplements to consumers, and sells the NIAGEN NR ingredient to supplement brands and manufacturers. It also sells research reference standards and analytical testing to laboratories.

primary_products.value: NR dietary supplements; NR ingredient; research reference standards; NAD+ precursor products

customer_segment.value: B2C: consumers buying NR supplements online and in retail stores; B2B: supplement brands, food and beverage makers, pharmaceutical and research laboratories

end_markets.value: dietary supplements; nutrition; pharmaceuticals; life science research

revenue_model.value: product sales: consumer supplements and bulk NR ingredient sold to manufacturers; service fees: analytical testing and laboratory services for customers

value_chain_position.value: brand owner: markets Tru Niagen supplements sold to consumers; component supplier: supplies NIAGEN NR ingredient to supplement makers

geography_served.value: global: sales to consumers and customers in the United States and many other countries

specialization.value: niche specialist: focused on NAD+ precursor nicotinamide riboside and related reference standards

distribution_channels.value: online: company website and major e-commerce marketplaces; third-party retail: national retail chains and warehouse clubs selling supplements; direct sales: ingredient sales teams serving supplement manufacturers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: dietary supplement rules and health claim regulation by the FDA and FTC, quality standards for ingredients

notes: Product and channel details are from general knowledge and may have changed; revenue and business mix not described.
